tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches s_grad = 2.44, just below the archived avalanche onset range of 2.50–2.68. The observed flattening does not distinguish smooth saturation from a downturn that begins beyond the pilot range. The high-gradient probe directly tests that distinction.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Below the candidate threshold, this model and its avalanche extension make identical predictions. A good pilot fit would not justify extrapolating above the threshold.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the supercritical avalanche model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five pilot gradients are below the archived threshold range, so neither the threshold nor the strength of the avalanche penalty can be estimated.
It costs more and targets time-dependent behavior rather than the unresolved high-gradient branch.
